summary: Drugs Made In America Acquisition Corp. (DMAA), a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 3 to its merger agreement with Power Analytics Global Corp (PAGC). The amendment requires the former sponsor to forfeit at least 50% of founder shares, with the remainder subject to earnout vesting at $12.50 and $15.00 price targets. Additionally, 430,000 sponsor private placement rights are surrendered for no consideration, and 45,092 ordinary shares from unfunded subscription are cancelled. The business combination will see PAGC merging into DMAA, with the surviving entity trading on Nasdaq. Watch for shareholder vote and redemption risks.
